description: The **MIXED multi-family DAG preset** is validated end to end: MiniMax M3 plans and implements, GPT-5.6 Luna architects, and Qwen3 Flash verifies, so the verifier never shares a model family with the implementor.
Subagents that hard-fail on a structured-output request now switch once to their configured fallback model instead of ending the run with a provider error.
Models can declare `supports_structured_output = false`, which routes them through the StructuredOutput tool path instead of a native `response_format` request the provider would reject.
The **DAG health watcher** (`dag-watch`) and the preset smoke checker now ship to all users instead of living only in a local setup.
**DeepSeek verifiers** no longer stall the DAG with `response_format type is unavailable`; that failure is now treated as fallback-worthy.
**Qwen structured output** wrapped in a single-element array is unwrapped to the expected object before schema validation.
**MiniMax responses** that omit `created` or `prompt_tokens` now deserialize instead of failing the whole turn.
**`gpt-5.6-luna`** uses `api_backend = "responses"` in every preset, which is the only backend where its tool calls work.
**`minimax-m3`** is marked as not supporting structured output, preventing a provider HTTP 400 on every schema request.
**Per-model config overrides** now honor `supports_structured_output`; the field was previously parsed and silently discarded.
**The FULL preset verifier** is now `grok-4.5`, which handles response schemas natively.
**The reported version** matches the source tree again; earlier commits claimed 0.2.120 while the crate manifests still said 0.2.119, so the built binary printed a stale version.
Failed structured-output attempts fall back once instead of exhausting the full schema retry budget, so a mismatched verifier model costs far less time per run.
